content:
sasha: AM async — quick standup: landed a small change to the flow-slot warmup heuristic that should reduce cold-penalty tail for short sequences.

sasha: what I did: updated slot prefetch to prefer recently-hot slots instead of strict LRU, added a tiny backoff for microbursts.

sasha: blockers: saw one flaky test locally around kv-eviction timing, need infra to repro on canary.

sasha: today: open PR for review, run canary on two dedicated nodes after lunch.

maria: nice work. left a couple of comments on the PR re: metrics tags. can you add model_id + route in the span? :eyes:

kai: pinging infra: @lee can you give me a heads-up about the node rotation window? we shouldn't start canary during the rolling update.

lee: infra window is 13:00–13:30 UTC for zone-a maintenance. avoid starting canary until 13:40.

sasha: thanks @lee. will schedule canary for 13:45.

maria: perf-bot posted a baseline snapshot this morning, attaching numbers for short-seq workload.

perf-bot: ```
Run: short-seq-1024x
Baseline (no warmup): p50=24ms p95=89ms p99=123ms
With flow-slot warmup: p50=22ms p95=72ms p99=108ms
Tokens/sec +11% overall
Memory delta: +1.8% (within budget)
```

kai: those p99 gains look promising. can we add a quick smoke that validates kv-hit ratio before/after? want to be sure improvement isn't from reduced batching.

sasha: good call — I'll add a smoke that logs kv_hit_rate and batch_size distribution. prototype snippet:

```
# small smoke harness
for i in range(1000):
  send(req(seq_len=16))
  metrics.collect(["kv_hit_rate","avg_batch_size"])
```

sasha: expecting kv_hit_rate to go up for repeated short calls.

maria: also put a prometheus label so we can slice by route. otherwise the dashboard aggregates too much.

lee: FYI infra noticed increased scheduling churn on canary group yesterday — might be related to slot pinning. will watch during canary run.

kai: if infra sees churn, fallback plan is to flip a runtime flag to disable slot-warming for that group and roll back. simple config: `enable_flow_slot_warmup=false`.

sasha: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/flow-slot-warmup/pull/214 — PTAL @maria @kai.

maria: reviewing now. will try to get it in before 13:30 so you can run the canary at 13:45.

perf-bot: quick alert: the nightly microburst test shows a small regression for some long-seq cases (p95 +4%). tagging @eng-runtime.

kai: noted. that might be due to the warmup backoff; need to ensure we only change heuristics for short sequences. add a sequence-length cutoff to the heuristic.

sasha: good point — will add `if seq_len <= 64: prefer_hot_slots()` guard.

lee: infra will put the canary on a non-rotating subset to reduce noise. I'll DM the exact hosts.

maria: final note — add a quick e2e that runs one shot of the large-seq benchmark to catch regressions in CI. keep it gated on a fast flag so CI cost is small.

sasha: done. thanks everyone — I'll merge after maria's sign-off and kick the canary at 13:45 UTC. will post results in this thread. :thumbsup:

maria: :+1:

kai: :rocket:

perf-bot: canary scheduled at 1719072350 UTC on group flow-warmup-canary. metrics will stream to /dash/canary/flow-warmup.

sasha: leaving the thread open for results. if anyone sees abnormal tail latencies, ping here immediately.

lee: will monitor infra side and call a pause if churn > 2% for 10m.

sasha: thanks — signing off for now, will update after canary completes.
